card.title: 9th BERSAGLIERI
card.text: Destruction: Shuffle 18th BERSAGLIERI into your deck.
card.flavorText: Formed in 1871, the 9th Bersaglieri Regiment was an elite infantry unit of the Italian Army, known for its speed and aggressive tactics. After serving on the Italian front during World War I, it was disbanded following heavy losses at Caporetto in 1917. The regiment was reconstituted in 1919 and saw combat again during WWII. Assigned to the Western Desert campaign, the 9th Bersaglieri deployed to North Africa alongside other units of the Italian Army. It fought as part of the Axis effort to control the region, facing British and Commonwealth forces across the harsh desert terrain. In October 1942, during the Second Battle of El Alamein, the regiment was overwhelmed. Under relentless Allied artillery fire and air attacks, it suffered severe losses and was ultimately destroyed. This battle marked a turning point in the North African campaign, forcing Axis forces into a long retreat. Decorated for valor in earlier conflicts, the 9th Bersaglieri maintained a reputation for resilience and discipline, even in the face of defeat. The regiment was officially disbanded on 5 November 1942 following its destruction.
